notificationsDesc.zh: 任务完成或等待你处理时，用系统通知提醒
notificationsDesc.en: Show a system notification when a task finishes or waits on you

notificationPermissionDefault.en: The browser has not allowed notifications yet.

notificationPermissionDenied.zh: 浏览器已拒绝通知，请在站点设置里开启。
notificationPermissionDenied.en: Notifications are blocked. Turn them on in the site settings.

notificationUnsupported.zh: 当前页面不能显示系统通知。
notificationUnsupported.en: This page cannot show system notifications.

notificationChannelHost.zh: 由桌面端直接发送系统通知。
notificationChannelHost.en: The desktop app delivers these system notifications directly.

notificationChannelUnsupported.zh: 当前环境没有可用的系统通知通道。
notificationChannelUnsupported.en: This environment has no system notification channel.

notificationClickUnavailable.zh: 点击通知只会打开窗口，不切换会话。
notificationClickUnavailable.en: Clicking a notification opens the window without switching sessions.
